tools.name: neuron_jobs
tools.description: Lists CRM jobs (work orders), newest first by when the job was CREATED, and returns from, to, count, truncated, and items. Each item has id, createdAt, status, date (scheduled date), service, city, total (job total in dollars, 0 when not set), and customer. Use it for work created in a past period;

tools.name: neuron_contacts
tools.description: Searches the business's CRM customers and returns query, count, truncated, and items; the whole customer list is never returned. Each item has id, name, phone, email, language, type, source, and updatedAt. Use it to look up one customer; use neuron_leads or neuron_calls for recent inbound requests.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: neuron_calls, neuron_inbox, neuron_contacts · Private data: neuron_calls, neuron_leads, neuron_jobs, neuron_business, neuron_bookings, neuron_contacts · Public sink: neuron_calls, neuron_inbox, neuron_bookings, neuron_contacts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: neuron_calls, neuron_inbox, neuron_contacts · Private data: neuron_calls, neuron_leads, neuron_jobs, neuron_business, neuron_bookings, neuron_contacts · Public sink: neuron_calls, neuron_inbox, neuron_bookings, neuron_contacts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
